name: e-pharmacy
description: E-PHARMACY monorepo: client storefront, pharmacy cabinet, admin dashboard and shared API.

scripts.check:before-deploy: pnpm lint && pnpm type-check && pnpm build
scripts.check:client: pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client lint && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client type-check && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/client build
scripts.check:api: pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api lint && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api type-check && pnpm --filter @e-pharmacy/api build
